detail.longDescription: arXiv:2609.28002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents an LLM-assisted workflow for visualizing structural differences in evolving software require- ments. Implemented in the OntologyWeb environment, the work- flow represents baseline and current requirements as triple-based semantic graphs and supports side-by-side comparison of curated graph snapshots. The comparison view aligns matched entities and uses visual encoding to highlight structural changes.
